scope: Only the previously unexecuted reincarnator scenario. Runtime sources unchanged from 92a865b; bfea09e adds scenario/runner selection and timeout. Three paired seeds plus three seed731 timing repeats.

a2_vs_original.scope: First differences are first observed checkpoints, not first causal interactions. Population order, membership, seats, culls and entity flags are exact decisions; RNG, network hashes and observer-derived dominant paths are reported separately. Pointwise entity numbers cease after discrete/RNG divergence because names may be reused after death. Common names after that point measure overlap, not lineage. World/network numerical distances and empirical population distributions remain descriptive. Unknown/nonfinite values are counted. A null first numeric checkpoint with censoring does not mean no numerical drift; exact first entity drift is unavailable from the censoring point. Flattened numerical comparisons assume the fixed schema/network architecture of this experiment. No equivalence or distribution-generalization claim beyond samples.
